mapper.select: SELECT i.player_id AS playerId, p.name AS playerName, i.npc_id AS npcId, n.name AS npcName, i.`value` AS value FROM intimacy i LEFT JOIN npc n ON i.npc_id = n.id AND n.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN player p ON i.player_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.npc_id = #{npcId} ORDER BY i.`value` DESC

SELECT i.player_id AS playerId, p.name AS playerName, SUM(i.`value`) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT i.npc_id) AS npcCount FROM intimacy i LEFT JOIN player p ON i.player_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.player_id, p.name ORDER BY total DESC
SELECT FROM intimacy WHERE player_id = #{playerId} AND npc_id = #{npcId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO intimacy (player_id, npc_id, `value`, deleted, updated_at) VALUES (#{playerId}, #{npcId}, #{value}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE intimacy SET `value` = #{value}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE player_id = #{playerId} AND npc_id = #{npcId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE intimacy SET deleted = 1 WHERE player_id = #{playerId} AND npc_id = #{npcId} AND deleted = 0
